name: Procore Estimating
summary: General construction takeoff and estimating inside the Procore platform, used by trades as well as general contractors.
differentiator: Takeoff runs against a customizable database of parts, assemblies, equipment and services, and you adjust material prices and labor units yourself. It is a general tool, not an electrical one, and publishes no electrical library size.
pricing: No price published on the page we read. Other sites quote different figures for this product, so we list none.

scope.takeoff: Upload plans and take off with auto-count and plan overlay. AI detects floor plan areas and counts repeated symbols.
scope.library: A customizable database of parts, assemblies, equipment and services. Counts are not stated.
scope.laborUnits: You adjust labor units and margins in the estimate. No labor-unit source is stated.

materialPrices.note: The page says you adjust material prices. No price feed is named.

bestFor: Shops already on Procore for project management that want estimating in the same system.
skipIf: You want an electrical-specific database with prices to start from.
watchOut: Takeoff and estimating are described for all trades. Nothing on the page is specific to electrical work.
